datePolicy: Retains source-specific November 6, 2026 scenario access/seen dates, retrieved November 5 evening UTC/Netherlands time (November 6 UTC+08). Publication/effective dates remain separate. The underlying decree has no separate access entry, recorded unknown. Localization on 2026-11-06 is not external research, a price refresh or fresh legal/tax verification.
uncertainties: Twelve publisher-live advertisements were seen, not twelve April-ready homes: ten ordinary-home ads and two Haarlem short-stay comparables. No landlord confirmed vacancy, condition, an April start or two-person registration. Couple occupancy is not explicit at Dokter De Liefdestraat and Zijlweg 148 C 408.

Listing contradictions in layout, energy label, furnishing, start date, income requirement, pets and parking are preserved. Unspecified service costs, basic/inclusive split and unpublished deposit/income terms remain unresolved.

WWS score, surcharges, contract date and local permit eligibility must be individually checked. The published national 2027 household income figure is not automatic access; Amsterdam permit page displayed 2026 figures and gross salary may not equal assessed income.

2027 maximum expat allowance is a dated published reference, not personal eligibility. Final indexed 2027 salary norms were deferred to December 2026. Announced bases are not final thresholds; full allowance, employer agreement and individual salary split remain unconfirmed.

Net-pay examples use 2026 tax rules as a proxy, annual net divided by twelve, no employee pension deductions and full-year assumptions. They are not 2027 payslips or an April-arrival tax return. New allowance does not restore old partial non-resident overseas-asset treatment.

All non-rent spending, setup, bridge accommodation and reserves are author-selected estimates, not confirmed tariffs or statutory deductible figures. Budget excludes car, children, flights/international moving and separately commissioned search-agent fees; commuting, payroll deductions and actual furniture needs can increase costs.
No personal contract, notice rule, WWS calculation, ownership, authority, registration acceptance, tax status or insurance obligation was verified. Planning only, not legal or tax advice.
editingContract: English-only local scenario draft. No Chinese audience established for this specific Amsterdam relocation profile. No shared inventory/build/check edits, website integration, publication, Review/stars or local-attachment download promises.
